update.name: useGame — Major Patch: Energy + Round Flow + Skill Logging
update.context: useGame.ts is the central state machine for Farkle Frenzy. This patch wires in: energy system round flow, skill decision logging, SixPoolManager for tile spawning, Wild Blocker resolution, and the new round end conditions (SHORT_CHAIN, FARKLE, ENERGY_ZERO). MUST run after update-39 (useEnergy exists) and update-38 (skillMetrics exists).

file.description: Replace the entire useReducer implementation with the V3 architecture.

constraints.constraint: CASCADE uses setTimeout recursion — never setInterval.
SixPoolManager lives in useRef — not in reducer state.
Analytics calls are fire-and-forget — never block the game loop.
Chain minimum of 2 enforced here only — not in scorer.
Bombs are Cell.type values — never add activeBombs array to state.
Do not regenerate AP system, speedMeter, or old Frenzy boolean.
React.StrictMode is disabled — do not add it.

do-not.rule: Do not add activeBombs array or ActiveBomb interface to GameState.
Do not use setInterval for cascade or energy.
Do not regenerate SpawnPool class — use SixPoolManager.
Do not add recoverDeadBoard() or ensurePlayableGrid() — deleted.
Do not use Math.random() for any game event.
Do not use SP_FREE or SP_CASINO mode names — use SOLO_FREE/SOLO_CASINO.

verification.check: Chain of length 1 does not commit (minimum 2 enforced)
Chain of length 2-5 with score > 0 triggers AUTO-BANK then ROUND_END
Chain of length 6 with score > 0 does NOT end round — CONTINUE
Farkle resets unbanked to 0 and multiplier to step 0
BOMB_STANDARD placed when isSixOfAKind is true
BOMB_RAINBOW placed when isStraight is true
